| καί σφεας φωνήσας ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (whole-line speech introduction, 4.284 = 4.337; departure from odyssey-014, where the same line is "and having spoken to them, winged words he spoke:" / "and speaking up to them, spoke winged words") | "and, lifting his voice, to them winged words he spoke:" | "and lifting his voice he spoke winged words to them:" | the Odyssey's "having spoken to them" / "speaking up to them"; the Iliad has already fixed φωνήσας as "lifting his voice" (καί μιν φωνήσας …, 1.201 and 2.7), and the same participle takes the same English with σφεας "to them"; only the pronoun differs from those lines. The units are 283–284 and 336–337 (with the line before), so the validator's whole-unit rule is not engaged |
| καί μιν φωνήσας ἔπεα πτερόεντα προσηύδα (4.312; departure from 1.201 in the pronoun only) | "and, lifting his voice, to him winged words he spoke:" | "and lifting his voice he spoke winged words to him:" | "to her" (the published English of 1.201, where μιν is Athena; here μιν is Nestor); the unit is joined to 4.311 so that the whole-unit rule does not force the wrong pronoun, as at 2.7 |
